handoff: Approve: the tick record carries sync + timing (observe phases with call counts, decide, each action's result.ms incl. claim.renew, after), tick.end/norn tick name the slowest phase, story list and the cockpit show the last tick's duration; fields optional, outside facts/action. review#1 F1 (real-tick integration test) and F2 fixed, F3/F4 documented; test#2 green. One nit: per-story git and process probes share the stories phase.

findings.title: Per-story git and process probes share one `stories` phase
findings.detail:
The spec lists 'per-story git, runner, process' separately; git and process probes per story are timed together under `stories` (process probes for leases fall under `local`). This is documented in docs/recipes.md and enough to tell a sync from local work.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Split later if a slow `stories` phase needs explaining.
